title: Jesse's month of bad luck after the visit, including an armed gunman

tellings.quote: building we work at, and an armed gunman runs into the building.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after a visit, around 2021 or 2022, he had a month of bad luck in Los Angeles. Among the events, he says, an armed gunman ran into the building where he works, and he tells it as if the trouble might be tied to the visit.
